_: Her metal's finish by material key (outfit_materials.json kind metal; shaders/heroine_outfit_metal.gdshader's finish). Any key not here is bare: as built. blued: blued steel, deep blue-black, chipped back to bright steel at its worn edges (the look bible's armor-metal page, item 4).

pieces._: by key, then outfit.piece (the piece's name's first word): its own metal_rough and metal_env_graze. Metal r4: the Warden's greaves and sabatons, smoother with more edge sheen (a cylinder's highlight is a line); her cups and pauldrons keep the key's 0.45 / 0.3. Armor 12 (c3): the cuirass's plate (piece word 'plate': only the cuirass has one; set 'plate' is every plate_* armor mesh) a step crisper at 0.38, its patina's patches halved (metal_blot, 1 the key's own).
